messages:
maria: Heads-up: new hire's sample app in onboarding repo fails on Cloudflare Workers when importing our JS SDK. Repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/onboarding-samples/tree/main/worker-quick-start

devon: What's the runtime error?

maria: Worker throws: 'TypeError: default is not a constructor' after this import:
```js
import Redwood from '@redwood-inference/js';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: RW_KEY });
```

aj: That's an ESM/CJS interop issue. Workers expect native ESM; if package exports resolve to CJS consumers get the wrong module shape.

sophia: I inspected the published tarball: package.json's exports point to a single CJS file under a nonstandard key. Bundlers/edge runtimes can end up loading the CJS artifact.

maria: This is blocking the onboarding flow for a new hire. Can we patch quickly?

devon: Proposed quick fix for package.json exports:
```
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "types": "./dist/index.d.ts",
    "import": "./dist/index.esm.mjs",
    "require": "./dist/index.cjs.js"
  },
  "./package.json": "./package.json"
}
```
This gives import/require signals and exposes types to TS resolvers.

aj: Also add a dedicated './edge' subpath pointing to a minimal ESM-only bundle (dist/index.edge.mjs) that strips node-only deps. That makes Cloudflare/Vercel pick the worker-optimized artifact.

sophia: Add typesVersions fallback for older TS so editors find the d.ts. And ensure dist/index.esm.mjs exports a default for `import X from` interop.

devon: I'll open a PR with exports change + tiny edge build + a CI smoke test that bundles the sample with esbuild and runs it in a local worker runner. Will include a short release note about the change.

ci-bot: buildkite: unit tests passed on main. No worker smoke tests were configured previously.

maria: Thanks. Please paste the PR link here and I'll validate the onboarding sample once it lands.
